summary: Completed testing of per-tile transformation effects and campaign attribution features. Transformation works correctly on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080) with staggered timing, no reload, and no visual breakage. Campaign attribution flow verified end-to-end: URL params captured in sessionStorage, persisted across navigation, and correctly displayed in Admin Campagne page. Admin link generator working. Language is fully Italian. Minor issues with video autoplay detection and scroll test inconsistency (likely test artifacts, not blocking bugs).

minor_issues.issue: Allows publishing model without age confirmation when expected to return 400
minor_issues.impact: Validation bypass - model can be published without conferma_maggiorenne check

performance_issues.issue: Video autoplay detection showed 0/4 videos playing on desktop, but videos have correct attributes (muted, loop, playsInline, autoplay)
performance_issues.impact: May be browser autoplay policy or timing issue, not a code bug

test_artifacts.issue: Page was already scrolled to position 594 when test started, making scroll test inconclusive. Desktop scroll test passed.
test_artifacts.impact: Test artifact, not a real bug. Likely caused by cookie consent banner or other UI elements.
